questions.question: In a ΔABC, D, E and F are the mid-points of side BC, CA and AB respectively. If BC = 25.6 cm, CA = 18.8 cm and AB = 20.4 cm, what is the perimeter (in cm) of the ΔDEF?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a ΔABC, D, E, and F are the mid-points of side BC, CA, and AB respectively.

BC = 25.6 cm, CA = 18.8 cm and AB = 20.4 cm

**Concept used:**

Midpoint theorem - The line segment in a triangle joining the midpoint of two sides of the triangle is said to be parallel to its third side and is also half of the length of the third side.

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/567f9a9b795ff04099ca3a391a10bb3672003cc3fd321d1dc6f842237ba74cd2.png] 

E and F are the mid point of the side AC and AB 

⇒ AE = EC and AF = FB

⇒ AE/EC = AF/FB

By mid point theorem 

⇒ EF = BC/2

⇒ EF = 25.6/2

⇒ EF = 12.8 cm

Similerly,

DE = AB/2

⇒ DE = 20.4/2 

⇒ DE = 10.2 cm

FD = AC/2 

⇒ FD = 18.8/2

⇒ FD = 9.4 cm

The perimeter (in cm) of the ΔDEF

⇒ DE + EF + FD 

⇒ 10.2 + 12.8 + 9.4

⇒ 32.4 cm

**∴ The perimeter (in cm) of the ΔDEF is 32.4 cm.**

questions.solution:

Successive discounts of 20% and 35%.

Cost price = Rs. 4580

⇒ Total discount = 55 - 7 = 48%

⇒ Sale price = 4580 × 52/100

**∴ The final sale price (in Rs, to the nearest rupee) is 2382.**

questions.question: Find the sum of the greatest and the smallest number which may replace k in the number 3281k6 to make the number divisible by 6.
questions.solution:

The sum of the greatest and the samallest number may replace k in

The number 3281k6 to make the number divisible by 6 

**Formula used:**

Divisible = sum of the digits 

**Calculation:**

If the number is divisible by 6 then it is also divisible by 2 and 3 

Last number is even so the number id divisible by 2

Divisible by 3 = 3 + 2 + 8 + 1 + K + 6 

⇒ 20 + K 

Put K = 1 (minimum)

⇒ 20 + 1 = 21 divisible by 3 

Put K = 7 ( maximum)

⇒ 20 + 7 = 27 divisible by 3

 Sum = minimum + maximum 

⇒ Sum = 1 + 7 = 8 

**∴ The sum of the greatest and the smallest number is 8.**

questions.question: Anil lent a sum of Rs. 5,000 on simple interest for 10 years in such a way that the rate of interest is 6% per annum for the first 2 years, 8% per annum for the next 2 years and 10% per annum beyond 4 years. How much interest (in Rs.) will he earn at the end of 10 years?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Anil lent a sum of Rs. 5,000 on simple interest for 10 years

Rate = 6% for first 2 years, 8% for next 2 years, and 10% per annum by 4 years

**Formula used:**

Simple interest(S.I) = Principal(P) × rate(R) × Time(T)

**Calculation:**

Interest earn ( 10 years ) = 6% for 2 years + 8% for next 2 year + 10% for further 6 years

⇒ Interest earn = 6 × 2 + 8 × 2 + 10 × 6

⇒ Interest earn =12% + 16% + 60% 

⇒ Interest earn = 88%

⇒ 88% of 5000 = 88 × 5000 /100 = 4400.

**∴ He earn at the end of 10 years is Rs. 4400.**

questions.question: The distance between two stations A and B is 200 km. A train runs from A to B at a speed of 75 km/h, while another train runs from B to A at a speed of 85 km/h. What will be the distance between the two trains (in km) 3 minutes before they meet?
questions.solution:
**Given:** 

The distance between two stations A and B is 200 km.

A train runs from A to B at a speed of 75 km/h, another train runs from

B to A at a speed of 85 km/h

**Formula used:**

Distance = Speed × time 

Relative speed = speed of train A + speed of train B

**Calculation**:

⇒ Speed of train A = 75 km/hr

⇒ Speed of train B = 85 km/hr

⇒ Relative speed = 75 + 85 = 160 km/hr

⇒ Distance = speed × time

⇒ 200 = 160 × t 

⇒ T = 5/4 hr 

⇒ T = 5/4 × 60 

⇒ Total time = 75 min 

⇒ Distance traveled in 72 min 

⇒ Distance traveled = 160 × (72/60) = 192

**∴ Distance between trains = 200 - 192 is 8km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__** Relative speed = 75 + 85 = 160 km/hr.

Distance travelled in 3 min = 3/60 × 160 = 8KM

Distance between trains 3 min before they meet will be equal to the total distance traveled by both the trains in 3 min

∴ Distance between trains = 8km.

questions.question: A and B working alone can complete a work in 8 days and 12 days, respectively. They started working together, but A left 2 days before completion of the work. In how many days was the work completed?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A and B working alone can complete a work in 8 days and 12 days, respectively. 

They started working together, but A left 2 days before the completion of the work.

**Formula used :**

Efficiency = Work/Day

**Calculation:**

A = 8 days, B = 12 days

Total work = L C M of (8, 12 ) = 24 

Efficiency of A = 24/8 = 3

Efficiency of B = 24/12 = 2 

Last two days work done by B

Last two days work = 2 × 2 = 4 

Remaining work = 24 - 4 = 20 

Work done by ( A + B ) = 3 + 2 = 5 

Number of days Remaining work/ 5 + last 2 days 

⇒ 20/5 + 2 = 6

**∴ The work completed was 6 days .**

questions.question: Person A started a business by investing Rs. 65,000. After a few months, B joined him by investing Rs. 50,000. Three months after the joining of B, C joined the two with an investment of Rs. 55,000. At the end of the year, A got 50% of profit as his share. For how many months did A alone finance the business?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Person A started a business by investing Rs. 65,000.

After a few months, B joined him by investing Rs. 50,000.

Three months after the joining of B, C joined the two with an investment of Rs. 55,000.

A got 50% of profit as his share.

**Formula used:**

Profit ratio = Investment1 × Time₁ : Investment₂ × Time₂ : ........... Investmentₙ × Timeₙ

**Calculation:**

Let B invest the amount after x months

A invest for 12 month

B invest for (12 - x)

​⇒ (12 - x) months

Three months after the joining of B, C joined the two with an investment of Rs. 55,000.

C invest for (12 - x - 3)

⇒ (9 - x)

Profit share = A : B : C

Profit share = 65,000 × 12 : 50,000 × (12 - x) : 55,000 × (9 - x)

⇒ 156 : 10(12 - x) : 11(9 - x)

A got 50% of profit as his share

⇒ 156/(156 + 120 - 10x + 99 - 11x) = 1/2

⇒ 312 = 375 - 21x

⇒ 21x = 63

⇒ x = 3 month 

**∴ A alone finance the business for 3 month.**
